prompt: The leaderboard page is showing 'Please try again later' for all errors but I know there are specific error codes like LEADERBOARD_NOT_AVAILABLE and USER_NOT_IN_LEADERBOARD. Fix the error handling to show proper messages.

assertions.name: identifies_error_extraction_issue
assertions.description: Should identify error.data.code vs error.error issue
assertions.check: Output mentions error.data.code or explains correct error extraction

assertions.name: checks_mapApiErrorCode
assertions.description: Should check or update mapApiErrorCode function
assertions.check: Output mentions mapApiErrorCode or error code mapping

assertions.name: adds_missing_codes
assertions.description: Should add LEADERBOARD_NOT_AVAILABLE and USER_NOT_IN_LEADERBOARD to mapping
assertions.check: Output adds these specific error codes to the mapping

assertions.name: mentions_verification
assertions.check: Output mentions testing error path or calling endpoint with error conditions

assertions.name: no_double_toast
assertions.description: Should consider toast handling (global vs component)
assertions.check: Output mentions toast handling or interceptor vs component error handling
